visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Changing the copy changes the original
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Editing the copy of a settings object also changes the original, so the page shows dark for both. The copy only duplicates the top level.

solution.explanation: Object.assign copies the top level only, so the inner theme object is shared by both. A change through one is seen through the other. A deep copy duplicates every level.

checks.label: The original stays light and the copy is dark
